import asyncio
from fastmcp import Server
from fastmcp.shared_resources import Resource
from fastmcp.client import ClientSession


async def main():
    # Create FastMCP server
    server = Server(name="test-server")
    
    # Register a resource
    @server.resource(uri="data://config")
    async def get_config() -> Resource:
        return Resource(
            uri="data://config",
            mimeType="text/plain",
            text="This is the config content"
        )
    
    # Create in-memory client connected directly to server
    async with ClientSession(server) as client:
        # Fetch the resource
        resource = await client.read_resource("data://config")
        print(resource.text)


asyncio.run(main())

    # Create FastMCP server
    server = Server(name="test-server")

    @server.resource(uri="data://config")
